Description: Verify that PostgreSQL enforces TLS 1.2 minimum.
Risk: Older TLS versions are vulnerable to attacks.

Code.CLI: az postgres flexible-server parameter set -g <resource-group> -s <server-name> -n ssl_min_protocol_version -v TLSv1.2

Recommendation.Text: Review and implement the recommended configuration for Postgresql Flexible Server Minimum Tls Version Tls12.
